notes.title: 0.93.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🎮 Update v0.93.1.1_EA Notice[/h1]

[h3]🌍 Language Support[/h3]

Traditional Chinese language has been newly added!


[h3]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[b]Trait Value Changes[/b]

Overwhelm: 15% → 10%
Overwhelm+: 30% → 20%

[b]Difficulty System Overhaul[/b]

Difficulty selection has been changed from 5 levels to 4 levels (★★★★ removed)
Adventurer base stats have been adjusted to Normal difficulty (★★) standards
Overall stats of adventurers have been rebalanced
Some unit stats have been rebalanced

[b]Dungeon System[/b]

Unit slot addition upon dungeon rank up: 2 → 3


[h3]🔧 System Improvements[/h3]

[b]Trait System[/b]

Changed so that bonus health from traits also applies to maximum health

[b]Combat System[/b]

Unit movement speed adjusted to match action cycles
Improved so attacking units can catch up even when faster than adventurers
Changed so attacking units don't follow adventurers who are already in action


[h3]🎨 Visual Updates[/h3]

Added status effect graphics
Changed Demon [Venom] image
Changed Hero [Judgment] image


[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]

Fixed issue where [Vitality] trait displayed as negative when having bonus health
Fixed issue where [Hero's Blessing] trait wasn't being applied
Fixed issue where [Dungeon Master] trait wasn't being applied
Fixed issue where unit buff traits were incorrectly applied to adventurers
Fixed issue where forcing ending skip would freeze on black screen
Fixed issue where quest notification appeared in guild despite no quests on first playthrough
Fixed issue where some evolved unit images appeared as pre-evolution
Fixed issue where previous game logs remained when starting new game
Fixed issue where some adventurers wouldn't disappear, preventing turn start



[h3][b]❓ About Infinite Mode[/b][/h3]

We are currently working on several essential tasks for infinite mode.
While there are still many parts that need updates, we're considering releasing it in beta form first once the essential work is completed.
We promise an update in the near future. Thank you for your patience.


If you encounter any issues, please report them anytime through comments, community boards, or Discord!
Enjoy the game! 🎯

notes.title: 0.93 updates and notes
notes.notes:
[h2]⚠️ Important Notice[/h2]

We recommend starting a new game after updating. Existing save files may experience issues.
If you encounter progression blocks, translation problems, or bugs, please report them via Discord, comments, or the discussion board.


[h2]🆕 Major Updates[/h2]

[h3]🔄 Status Effect System[/h3]

Effects that directly impact character stats, with maximum stacking limits for each status
Most status effects activate at the end of a turn and reset at the start of the player's turn
Status and stat information can be viewed when hovering over units/adventurers
Adventurers without action points will receive [Fatigue] status when performing additional actions/combat (prevents infinite combat)
Detailed information about status effects can be found in the codex (graphics will be updated in future updates)


[h3]🔄 Trait System Overhaul[/h3]

Trait frames have been changed based on type
Changed the mechanism of traits that provide additional attacks based on stats
Before: Basic attack + Trait additional attack (2 attacks total) → After: Enhanced attack (1 attack)
Example) Iron Skin+ trait:
Before:

Basic attack for 80% ~ 120% of ATK (reduced by target's DEF)
Additional attack for 100% of DEF (not affected by target's DEF)
After:
ATK(base) + DEF(trait) for 80%~120% as one enhanced attack (reduced by target's DEF)

When multiple attack traits are present, all are combined into one powerful attack


[h3]🌟 New Traits Added[/h3]

Consecutive attacks: Double Strike, Triple Strike
Debuff traits: Apply status to opponents at the start of combat
Spores(Weakening), Acid(Corrosion), Thorny Vines(Slow), Golem(Misfortune)
Buff traits: Apply status to self at the start of combat
Succubus(Opportunity), Tough Skin(Protection), Wind(Acceleration), Assault(Sharpness)
Support traits: Elemental(Grants Elemental Blessing to units on the same floor)


[h3]🏆 New Artifacts[/h3]

Fortune Teller's Orb - Predicts the next random event


[h3]🏗️ Other Effect Changes[/h3]

Artifact - Hero's Token: Grants [Hero's Blessing] status to the player
Artifact - Touch of Decay: Grants [Curse] status to adventurers
Artifact - The 10th Treasures: Grants various statuses to allied units
Special Facility - Healing Facility: Grants [Robustness x 2] status to allied units each turn
Special Facility - Training Facility: Grants [Enhancement x 2] status to allied units each turn
Orb - Combat Crystal: Changed from +10% to all unit stats → Grants [Vigor] status to allied units


[h3]🖼️ Quest UI Changes[/h3]

Renamed from Quest to Dungeon Journal
Date display method has been improved for better readability
For specific date events, remaining days are displayed as D-number
For ongoing events, ○ and ● are used for display
○: Remaining days
●: Past days

Guild quests that previously occurred on fixed dates now occur on random dates
Events will now trigger even without dialogue interaction
Detailed information is recorded in the journal when you have conversations or gather information at the guild
Several new guild events have been added


[h3]📜 Other Changes[/h3]

Fixed display errors for artifact information at game start
Adjusted some playthrough bonus points
Adjusted stats for some units

notes.title: 0.92.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]📢 Patch Notes: Random Event System Added[/h2]

[h3]🎲 Random Event System[/h3]
We've added a new system that triggers random events based on the day count, affecting the entire dungeon!

[h3]✨ Key Features[/h3]
Events are categorized as good events and bad events
Higher difficulty increases the probability of bad events occurring
Random events are determined at the start of each new game and their order will not change with save & load

[h3]⚠️ Limitations[/h3]
Events will not occur on days 20/30
Events will not occur during your first playthrough

[h3]🔮 Current and Future Plans[/h3]
Currently implemented events: Events that apply immediately upon activation
Upcoming events:
Events that last for a certain period after activation
Neutral events and more

[i]Feature in development: The random event system is currently under development, and the presentation and system mechanics may be modified in the future.[/i]

[h3]Other Updates (0.91.1 Update)[/h3]
Fixed incorrect dialogue with Utori
Fixed a bug where previous traits remained after evolution and loading
Modified so that duplicate traits cannot be obtained
Limited the maximum number of traits to 10 (may be readjusted later)

notes.title: Game Release Schedule and Early Access Notice
notes.notes:
[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
“[Novice Dungeon Master] was initially conceived and developed as a single-player package game. Typically, single-player package games have endings, and once players complete them and experience most of the content, they usually finish the game and keep it as a memory.

We want to provide the best possible experience for that one playthrough. While the definition of the best gaming experience may vary from person to person, we believe that for the best gameplay, a game should be complete, bug-free, and have an intended beginning and end.

We're currently working towards that goal, but we need some time and feedback for completion, which led us to consider Early Access. Through our demo, we've been able to verify the core fun of the game. What remains is adding planned content, testing, and putting the final touches on the game.

We're not far from that goal, and we want to reach it through Early Access. Most of our main systems are already complete. While we wanted to take more time and release it as a full version, we decided to go with Early Access to show a more polished product and because we felt it was okay to share the current state with those waiting.”

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]
“Less than 6 months, and barring any variables, around 3 months.”
How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“During the Early Access period, we plan to implement balance adjustments based on feedback for better experience, add remaining content, and include more events. We'll add more diverse events and routes to make repeated playthroughs less monotonous.

Additionally, we'll be adding achievements, an infinite mode for playing beyond 30 days, and the final ending. This is the process of putting a true period to the journey with the protagonist.”

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
“It includes the 30-day dungeon experience, 6 different endings, and various elements for multiple playthroughs. Multiple playthroughs are supported, with each subsequent playthrough offering choices between more comfortable play and increased difficulty.

The current estimated playtime is around 6-10 hours.”

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]
“Since this Early Access is aimed at putting the finishing touches on the game, the price will remain the same as it is now.”

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]
“We will communicate through the Steam community and Discord. We'll post announcements and updates, and receive various feedback from players.”
